description: This file appears to be a PHP source code file for a test results management system, specifically handling the generation, display, and export of test result matrices within a testing framework. It includes functions for building matrices, exporting reports to spreadsheets, initializing GUI components, and managing build data sets.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: A class for rendering rich JavaScript-based tables with grouping and filtering features used in HTML report display.

classes.name: tlHTMLTable
classes.description: A class for rendering HTML tables for test results when format is not HTML.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks if a user has rights to access test plan metrics in a given project.

methods.name: buildMatrix
methods.description: Builds a rich table component (ext-js) to display the test result matrix.

methods.name: createSpreadsheet
methods.description: Generates an Excel spreadsheet report of test results, optionally emailing it or prompting for download.

methods.name: setUpBuilds
methods.description: Initializes build data set for report generation.

methods.name: buildDataSet
methods.description: Constructs the detailed data set of test case results for display or export.

methods.name: initLblSpreadsheet
methods.description: Initializes labels used in spreadsheet exports.

methods.name: setCellRangeSpreadsheet
methods.description: Creates cell range labels (A, B, ..., Z, AA, AB, ...) for spreadsheet columns.

methods.name: xlsStepOne
methods.description: Populates initial cells in the Excel spreadsheet with report headers and setup.

methods.name: initCols
methods.description: Initializes column mapping for data extraction based on whether platform info is shown.

methods.name: buildMailCfg
methods.description: Builds email configuration object for report email notifications.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes GUI data structures and fetches necessary metadata for report display.
